title: Best New Variety Top/Soft Fruit -- Winner: Driscoll's Victoria, Berry Gardens
summary: Driscoll's Victoria, grown by UK grower Berry Gardens (a Driscoll's growing partner), won HortWeek's Best New Variety (Top/Soft Fruit) award. Victoria is a large, sweet blackberry variety, in commercial production in California since 2005 and grown in the UK (Kent) by Berry Gardens/Salman's Farm.
why_it_matters: Confirms Victoria as a real, named, independently award-recognised Driscoll's blackberry variety grown commercially in the UK -- the grounding evidence for variety-victoria.
does_not_prove: current UK acreage as of 2026 (award and production reporting date to 2017/California-since-2005)

reading.rationale: Background grounding for a Variety entity, not an active analyst task.

commercial_position.rationale: Shows a named variety with independent trade-press award recognition and a real UK grower partner.

monitoring.rationale: An award and production report is a point-in-time result, not a recurring signal.
